Note: Site2Chat is the open-source, 100% free version of the website-to-chatbot tool. We are not affiliated with [site2chat.com](https://site2chat.com/).

# Site2Chat

> Turn any website into an AI chatbot in 2 minutes.

Site2Chat is a fast, no-code AI chatbot builder that automatically crawls and reads your public website pages, converts them into a searchable vector knowledge base, and deploys an interactive AI chatbot that answers visitor questions with verified citations from your site.

## Key Features

- **Automated Web Crawling & Ingestion**: Provide any website URL; Site2Chat crawls pages, extracts clean text, splits content into semantic chunks, and computes high-dimensional embeddings.
- **Strict RAG Retrieval**: Chatbot answers are strictly grounded in your crawled website content to prevent hallucinations and ensure accurate responses.
- **Multi-Model AI Flexibility**: Powered by lightning-fast Groq inference (Llama 3.3 70B Versatile) with optional Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) support for OpenRouter models.
- **Instant No-Code Embedding**: Standalone shareable public chat page and a lightweight 1-line script tag embeddable on any CMS or site builder in under 2 minutes.
- **Enterprise-Grade Security**: Secure Supabase authentication, encrypted API keys, and isolated chatbot data.
